definitions.explanation: A removable cushion or liner placed inside a shoe for comfort, support, or hygiene. Can also refer to a liner placed inside a drawer or container.

examples.japanese: ⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中敷|なかじ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I replaced the insoles in my shoes.

examples.japanese: {中敷|なかじ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れたら→入れる：01098_ireru⟧、⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{履|は}き{心地|ごこち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: After putting in insoles, the shoes became more comfortable to wear.

examples.japanese: ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{軽減|けいげん}する→軽減する：25372_keigensuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦クッション→クッション：10799_kusshon⟧⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧{中敷|なかじ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I use highly cushioned insoles to reduce foot fatigue.

notes:
A removable liner placed inside a shoe for comfort, support, or hygiene purposes.

COMPOUND: ⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧ (inside) + {敷|し}き (laying/spreading)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中敷|なかじ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to insert insoles
- {中敷|なかじ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to replace insoles
- {中敷|なかじ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧: to remove insoles
- ⟦クッション→クッション：10799_kusshon⟧{中敷|なかじ}き: cushioned insole
- ⟦{消臭|しょうしゅう}→消臭：21552_shoushuu⟧{中敷|なかじ}き: deodorizing insole

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦インソール→インソール：25739_insooru⟧: insole (loanword, often used for athletic or specialty insoles)

USAGE:
Widely available in Japan at shoe stores, drugstores, and {百均|ひゃっきん} (100-yen shops). Also used more broadly for any liner placed inside a drawer or container, though the shoe meaning is far more common.
